name: Mwangi Herbal Tradition
requirements: Must hail from the Mwangi Expanse or have lived there for at least 1 year
text: You are trained in a Mwangi tradition of herbalism dating back to the Age of Darkness and therefore have great insight into how to use the natural ingredients at your disposal to nurse an ailing body. You gain a +4 trait bonus on Heal checks when providing long-term care, and Heal is a class skill for you.
